Description
Investing in silver has proven to be valuable in the long run for investors and collectors because it retains its purchasing power. Thus, silver is associated with a safe asset. And when it comes to investing in silver, the primary choice for investors is the silver bar. Bullion Trading LLC introduces the 1 kilo Silver Bar(Random Design) at a low premium to add to your silver holdings. The silver bar consists of .999 fine silver and weighs approximately 32.15 Troy Ounce’s or 1 Kilo for those metric heads out there..
Silver, compared to other precious metals, has low production costs, so its premiums are low even though they’re of the finest quality. Also, an appealing factor for precious metal investors is the easy storage and stacking of silver bars, hence the reason for its popularity.
Bullion Trading Design of 1 Kilo Silver Bar – Random Design
The general description for the 1 Kilo Random Silver Bar may differ depending on the brand and mint. The product displayed here is only for reference, and the bar we ship you may not be the exact replica of the image. You can expect to receive the brand and type of the bar depending on our inventory and current stock. We guarantee the .999 purity and 1 Kilo weight of the bar.
The obverse of the bar may include the logo, carving of the brand, or the mint name of the bar. Generally, the bar’s mint, purity, weight, and brand name are engraved below the logo.
The reverse of the bar may include the security features, designs, or any patterns. Depending on the silver bar, it can also consist of the serial number or some unique identifier.
Although these bars do not have the assays with them they are tested by us and verified as being genuine and the correct purity, so you can be reassured you are receiving genuine product.

Contains .999 fine silver for a 32.15 Oz Silver Bar (1 Kilo)
